pause.description: Pausing holds every agent on {{computer}}, in every realm, before its next step. Messages you send are taken and wait. A step already running finishes. Shell jobs keep running. Nothing is cancelled.
pause.strip: Paused · turns wait at their next step
pause.band: Agents on {{computer}} are paused. Messages you send are taken and wait for Resume.
pause.unsure: Agents on {{computer}} may be paused: the answer to the last change didn't arrive. We are checking.
pause.readFailed: Couldn't read whether agents on {{computer}} are paused.
pause.setFailed: The agent refused the change, so nothing changed ({{code}}).
pause.setFailedNoCode: The agent refused the change, so nothing changed.
